flat_block_baseline.interpretation: Four objective straight-versus-curly apostrophe transcription defects were corrected in truth. Every remaining missing source phrase is present in a block removed as a header. The dominant representation failure remains multiple intended regions collapsing into one live block, followed by page titles being removed as headers without cross-page recurrence evidence.

hierarchical_region_audit.representation: root to aligned-flow to paragraph-block hierarchy over deduplicated pre-block geometric spans
hierarchical_region_audit.anchor_assignment: uniquely shortest normalized containing region; equal best matches remain ambiguous
hierarchical_region_audit.interpretation: The pre-block spans retain coherent visual-line text. Preserving them in aligned local flows and splitting paragraph blocks before flat layout fusion makes every frozen truth anchor independently addressable.

diagnostic_graph_result.decision: Do not promote projection. The hierarchy proves representation, but the old flat-column geometry evidence does not express parent, sibling-flow, or spanning-region order.

hierarchy_native_edge_result.decision: Retain hierarchy-native edges as diagnostic infrastructure. Holdout required-edge recall, ambiguity preservation, and valid-projection gates failed despite a 15.196-point F1 gain. The frozen stop rule prohibits projection promotion or post-holdout tuning.

determinism.stream_difference: Only document_finished.elapsed_ms varied; record order and all non-timing payload fields were identical.

follow_up_experiments.treatment: sparse page-wide occupancy plus repeated row-gap gutter recovery over content-stream spans
follow_up_experiments.reason: Below the 95 percent representation gate and regressed the existing two-column footer control.

follow_up_experiments.treatment: quality-gated glyph-first line spans with native gutter and opt-in row-gap recovery
follow_up_experiments.reason: Flattened line spans still discard the local region and fragment identity required by graph nodes.

follow_up_experiments.treatment: diagnostic large-gap fragments inside native lines plus opt-in row-gap region recovery
follow_up_experiments.reason: Preserving distant same-baseline fragments alone did not change any frozen anchor outcome; the missing unit is a hierarchical region and semantic-block representation.

follow_up_experiments.treatment: local large-gap fragments joined from the existing native baseline groups
follow_up_experiments.reason: The treatment inherited native baseline groups that had already interleaved characters from adjacent visual lines. Region splitting occurred after the destructive merge.

follow_up_experiments.treatment: strict glyph-bbox baseline bands followed by local large-gap splits and conservative vertical joins
follow_up_experiments.reason: The strict bands prevented the observed character interleaving but still failed to recover stable paragraph and semantic-region boundaries. The result was below the corrected 52-anchor baseline and exhausted the permitted revision.

follow_up_experiments.treatment: deduplicated pre-block visual lines grouped into stable x-aligned flows and paragraph blocks under an explicit root-flow-block hierarchy
follow_up_experiments.reason: Both development and holdout anchors resolve completely without changing frozen truth. Diagnostic graph projection remains below legacy because its geometry evidence still assumes flat page columns.

follow_up_experiments.treatment: sparse hierarchy-native sibling, local-boundary, spanning-fragment, and repeated-callout evidence with non-body side flows left disconnected
follow_up_experiments.reason: The first frozen treatment materially outperformed legacy, but missed two holdout required relations, asserted one declared ambiguous comparison, and produced one projection that violated truth. No post-holdout revision was permitted.

decision: Retain the hierarchical representation and hierarchy-native edges as diagnostic infrastructure. Do not promote projection. The next experiment must represent explicit section branches and continuation boundaries rather than infer them from pairwise geometry, and it must use a newly frozen corpus or preregistered rule before evaluation to avoid tuning on this exposed holdout.
